name: Valerian
short: No severe adverse events in a review of 60 studies (6,894 people). An interaction review found low interaction potential. A case report describes valerian-associated liver toxicity.
text: In a systematic review of 60 studies (6,894 participants), there were no severe adverse events associated with valerian intake in subjects aged between 7 and 80 years. A review of interaction data found that clinical studies of valerian preparations did not reveal any relevant interaction potential concerning the drug-metabolising enzymes CYP 1A2, 2D6, 2E1 and 3A4, and concluded that the interaction potential of valerian seems to be low and without clinical relevance. A published case report (title only; no abstract available) describes valerian-associated hepatotoxicity.
